name: apple-calendar
description: Access Apple Calendar on macOS via EventKit — list, search, create, update, and delete events with full support for recurring events, alarms, attendees, and free/busy availability.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Apple Calendar on your Mac via Apple's first-class EventKit framework. Full read+write coverage of the Calendar data model.

**Features:**
- Browse all calendars across all accounts (iCloud, Google/CalDAV, Exchange, Local, subscribed)
- List and search events by date range, calendar, and free text
- Full event detail — notes, URL, organizer, attendees and their responses, time zone
- Create events with recurrence rules, alarms, structured (geocoded) locations, and availability
- Edit recurring events per-occurrence or for all future occurrences (span control)
- Free/busy: merged busy intervals over any date range, for finding open slots
- Manage calendars themselves — create, rename, recolor, delete
- Deep-link any event via ical:// URL

**Requirements:**
- macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- Calendar permission with Full Access (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Calendars)

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List every event calendar on this Mac, with id, title, color, source, write-access flag, and which is the default

tools.name: create_calendar
tools.description: Create a new calendar with optional color and source/account

tools.name: update_calendar
tools.description: Rename or recolor an existing calendar

tools.name: delete_calendar
tools.description: Delete a calendar and all its events (destructive)

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Aggregate counts: calendar count, events today, events in the next 7 days, next upcoming event

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List event occurrences in a date range, with filters: calendars, text, all-day, canceled

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Free-text search across event titles, notes, and locations, within an optional date range

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full detail for an event — notes, organizer, attendees, recurrence, alarms, location, time zone

tools.name: get_event_link
tools.description: Get an ical:// URL that opens the event in Calendar.app

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Merged busy intervals (free/busy) within a date range — gaps between them are free slots

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create an event with full property set: notes, URL, location, recurrence, alarms, availability, time zone

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update any subset of an event's properties; occurrence_date + span control recurring-event scope; clear_* flags remove fields

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event or one/some occurrences of a recurring event (span controls scope)
